title: Lior and the Debt
author: Cyrus Eastwick
blurb: Lena Villalobos, an interpreter attached to a peace delegation destined to fail, works cases no one wants attributed. Then a stranger returns a favor that never happened, with interest owed — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must burn the network that did the training before the extraction flight leaves at dawn.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
